newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One-month to one-year Saudi t-bills mixed.
newsitem.headline: One-month to one-year Saudi t-bills mixed.

text.p: Yields were mixed on one-month to one-year Saudi treasury bills worth two billion riyals, a banker in Saudi Arabia said on Tuesday.
The yield on 28-day bills maturing on April 10 fell to 5.3332 percent from 5.3585 percent last week while the 91-day bills maturing on June 12 were unchanged at 5.4836 percent.
The yield on 182-day bills maturing on September 11 were steady at 5.6097 percent. The rate on 364-day bills maturing on March 12, 1998 rose to 5.9295 percent from 5.9034 percent.
They were priced at 99.58691, 98.63281, 97.24219 and 94.34375 respectively.
One-month interbank deposit rates were quoted at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, three months at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent, six months at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent and one year were at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent.
